visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a ROC military digital camouflage uniform and cap stands on a paved road with green trees and sunlight in the background. He shouts aggressively at the camera with an intense facial expression, pointing his finger forward. (2) He lifts a dark grey tumbler into the frame, demonstrating how to open the lid and take a drink. A yellow 'Drink Water' variety text appears as he gulps the water. (3) He continues his drill sergeant persona, gesturing emphatically while explaining the dangers of dehydration. He uses his hands to emphasize his points. (4) Stock footage inserts show a man sitting in a gym looking exhausted, followed by a close-up of someone unzipping their jeans. (5) The military man returns, explaining water intake calculations with text overlays showing 'Weight x 30-40ml'. He then pulls out a smartphone to use as a calculator. (6) A short clip of a classic 1980s Taiwanese military commercial featuring a young man on a phone appears. (7) The main character answers a phone call, transitioning into a product showcase. (8) Close-ups of the Woky tumbler with NASA branding are shown in a studio setting with dark backgrounds, highlighting the 'Pure Titanium' material and various color options. (9) The man concludes the video back on the wooded road, performing a military salute and a formal stand-at-ease posture.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator in military uniform, 1 man in gym stock footage, 1 man in classic commercial clip.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged male with a short beard, wearing a ROC Army digital camouflage uniform and matching patrol cap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary scene is an outdoor asphalt road surrounded by lush green trees under bright daylight. Secondary scenes include a gym with wooden walls, a black studio background for product shots, and a grainy vintage commercial background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a loud, aggressive male voice shouting in a drill sergeant style. No background music is present, creating a raw and intimidating atmosphere. (2) As the man produces a water bottle, a high-energy 'Ohhh!' crowd cheering sound effect is triggered. Short, sharp mechanical clicks are heard as the tumbler lid is manipulated. (3) An upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM starts, coinciding with the explanation of hydration. The vocal intensity remains high but becomes more instructional. (4) A comical elephant trumpet SFX plays when the speaker mentions 'Little brother kidney stones,' adding a humorous touch. (5) Fast digital 'cha-ching' and processing sounds occur as the hydration formula is displayed. (6) A classic telephone ringtone SFX interrupts the speech, followed by the muffled, lower-fidelity audio of an old commercial clip featuring a different male voice. (7) The master audio returns to a clean studio-grade narration for the Woky product highlight, featuring smooth transitions and subtle whoosh effects as different tumbler colors are showcased.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Woky's NASA-branded titanium tumblers by leveraging a popular Taiwanese military drill sergeant meme persona. The video uses humor and nostalgic cultural references to educate viewers on hydration before presenting the product as the ideal solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed feature listing, and brand logo overlays.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a high-arousal 'drill sergeant' persona to capture attention, typical of short-form social media marketing. The integration of the 'A-rong' military commercial meme provides a strong cultural anchor for the Taiwanese audience.
